gateways.title: Payment gateways
gateways.subtitle: Add your own gateway keys so payments land in your account. Paste the keys the gateway names in its dashboard.
gateways.banner: One gateway setup is used by your store checkout and Sales invoices.
gateways.viewOnly: You can see the gateway setup but not change it. Ask a workspace admin for permission to manage gateways.

scope.label: Where these settings apply
scope.workspaceHint: Used by every store and by Sales invoices, unless a store has its own override.
scope.storeHint: Used only by the checkout of {shop}. It wins over the workspace setup.
scope.noShop: Create a store first to set up an override.

resolved.noneHint: Set up a gateway below and switch it on. Until then buyers cannot pay online and invoices have no pay button.

catalogue.title: Gateways
catalogue.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, country or currency
catalogue.noDriversMessage: This server has no payment gateways to set up yet.
catalogue.noMatchMessage: Try another name, country or currency code.

card.unavailableNote: This gateway is listed but cannot take payments in this version yet.
card.migrated: Migrated from your storefront keys. Save once here to keep them in the new setup.
card.webhookMissing: Webhook secret missing: payment notifications from this gateway are refused until you add one.
card.notSetUp: Not set up for this scope yet.
card.removeMessage: Its saved keys are deleted for this scope ({scope}). Buyers can no longer pay through it and payments already in progress may not be confirmed.

test.fieldsOnly: Only the required fields were checked: this gateway has no cheap check call, so a payment is the real test.
test.rejected: The provider did not accept the keys.

drawer.secretsNote: Saved keys are never shown again. Only the end of each one is displayed as a reminder.
drawer.invalidOption: Choose one of the listed options for {field}.
drawer.modeHint: Use Test while you try the gateway with its test keys, and Live to take real payments.
drawer.activeHint: A gateway that is off is never used by the checkout or by invoices.
drawer.webhookHint: Paste this into your {name} dashboard so payments confirm automatically.
drawer.webhookAfterSave: The webhook address appears here after the first save.
drawer.willClear: The saved value will be removed when you save.
drawer.keepBlank: Leave blank to keep the saved value.
